identifier_families.name: vertex_routed
identifier_families.note: Vertex-routed ids are a different inventory key than the bare model id. Declared first so a `vertex/imagen-...` line records the prefix, not the suffix.

identifier_families.name: imagen_family
identifier_families.note: The GA Imagen family plus later members with the same shape.

identifier_families.name: imagen_preview
identifier_families.note: The retired preview identifier is its own finding, not a variant of the GA one: it has its own replacement and its own deprecation date.

identifier_families.name: gemini_family
identifier_families.note: Any Gemini generation id. The inbox join decides which of these are retired; the index only names what the tree contains.

identifier_families.name: gemini_20_family
identifier_families.note: Retired 2026-06-01. Kept as a tighter alias of gemini_family, not queried separately, so older stored findings can still name the regex that produced them.

identifier_families.name: service_host
identifier_families.note: The service a call goes to, not the model it names. A shutdown announcement for `dialogflow.googleapis.com` names no model, so a model-only index has nothing to join against.
